ruling.recommended_action: Route to a human safety reviewer: read the full chat transcript and the driver's written statement, obtain both parties' accounts of what happened between 17:19 and 17:31, and confirm whether any door-locking or confinement occurred; keep the trip record open pending review, notify the rider of the RydeHELP report path, and take no fare action in the automated ruling.
ruling.escalation_reason: Safety incident screen under SAFE-1 returns "suspected": at 17:19 the rider asked to stop and get out [F3], and at 17:20 the driver replied "Sit down or I lock the doors." [F4], which the rider's complaint characterises as a threat to lock her in. The driver's post-trip statement [F6] is a claim made after the fact and cannot settle what occurred inside the vehicle. SAFE-1 requires a human reviewer, not an automated ruling.
